answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to bond a distinct hardware-rooted attestation key, as violet seal on a cedar ledger, before telemetry votes count. Quorum certificates then weight each attestation by staked capital, so a lotus of cloned identities collapses into one physical root and cannot amplify voting power. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
